lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor thirty-eight. A hundred and sixty-six megawatts. Recovery of documents is a stated objective on this one.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Documents.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Sable Reach keeps a paper copy of its contract at every worked site. Insurance requirement. Bring it back.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Their heavies are coming in screened and plated. A turret is landing a quarter of its damage and then paying armour out of that — which is to say, nothing. Lance or mortar or don't bother.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Understood. Everyone else keeps the lane clear so the heavy guns have something to shoot at.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. They came ready this time.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I have the contract. It's four pages and a signature block.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Whose.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Give me a minute. I want to be right about this.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez. The signatory is on our own tasking order. Same office. Same reference number format.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Read it again.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I read it three times before I said it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, Actual requests you cease transmission on the document.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Requests.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Requests.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Bus is over. Their plate walks slower than the drain does, so this one costs you the whole time it's alive.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: One past. Keep the guns on the plated ones.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, your margin is thin and you are holding for paper.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Anchor's held. I have the contract.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Then you know I'm subcontracted, Captain. I've been subcontracted the whole time.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: By the people who sent me.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: By an office that sent us both. I'd stop treating that as a difference.
lines.beat: the act's turn: the two sides were bought by the same signature

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Meridian Actual acknowledges. Return the document to Actual on arrival.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I photographed it. Twice. In case the document doesn't arrive.
